name: e2a
description: Open-source email API for applications and AI agents — transactional sending from any product, per-agent two-way inboxes, structured SPF/DKIM/DMARC evidence, and a queryable event log. 79 MCP tools over hosted streamable HTTP with OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Open-source email API for applications and AI agents
interface.longDescription: Bundles the hosted e2a MCP server and five stable skills for setup, application integration, inbox operation, diagnosis, and evaluation — with structured inbound domain evidence, custom domains, attachments, and a replayable event log.
